## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (1)
- `GET /_sa_track/json/{jsonToken}` — Authenticate user session using a JSON token.

### Data Read (5)
- `GET /{id}` — Retrieve a specific Stocktwits message by ID.
- `GET /api/v3/homepage_cards/latest_analysis/most_viewed_unreads` — Get the most viewed unread analysis cards.
- `GET /api/v3/marketing_campaigns/{marketing_campaignId}` — Retrieve details of a specific marketing campaign.
- `GET /cdn/geo` — Retrieve geographical data.
- `GET /v1/personalize/simple` — Get personalized content recommendations.

### Data Write (2)
- `POST /mone_v2` — Submit data related to monetary transactions.
- `POST /p/insights/c/i` — Submit insights data.

### Media (2)
- `GET /cdn/finance-api/lua_charts` — Download financial chart data.
- `POST /assets/js/bundle` — Upload or process a JavaScript bundle.

### Realtime (1)
- `GET /livechat-public/v1/message/public` — Receive public live chat messages in real-time.

### Config (1)
- `GET /web-interactives/public/v1/embed/combinedConfigs` — Fetch configuration settings for embedded content.

### Core API (1)
- `GET /api/v3/{v3Id}` — Access core Stocktwits API data.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Stocktwits's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Stocktwits data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.stocktwits.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Stocktwits frontend uses
